title: Bounded Scout–Evaluate–Publish Loop
stealable_mechanism: Separate discovery, judgment, and publication into gated states with candidate and time budgets, explicit stop conditions, sanitized handoffs, deterministic checks, and a human-controlled final write.

title: Read-Only Repository Research Agent Rules
stealable_mechanism: Make “read-only” operational by enumerating allowed commands, forbidden side effects, untrusted-content handling, evidence standards, stop conditions, and a fixed findings report.

title: Change Verification Gate
stealable_mechanism: Convert “make the change” into a proof obligation: constrain scope, capture a baseline, run targeted and regression checks, inspect the full diff, and stop before merge.
